description: The Wedderburn-Etherington split of n. cross is the sum of a(i)*a(n-i) over the pairs below the middle, and middle is a(k)*(a(k)+1)/2 when n = 2k and 0 when n is odd. n = 6 gives cross 5, middle 1, and value 6. n runs from 1 to 80. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/wedderburn-split
